sentence: Ginormous borkledge means nothing if you flinch at the pig.

wombos.definition: Extremely large; of a size that exceeds what gigantic or enormous alone can adequately describe.
wombos.example: That burger was ginormous — I couldn't even finish half of it.

wombos.definition: Knowledge about John Pork — an understanding of his lore and world.
wombos.example: She passed the quiz because her borkledge was unmatched.
